title: Two messages arrive at the hotel
drDigitalIntro:
Two messages land while Dr. Digital is away. One is real. One is not.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

Open a message before judging it, and look at where the link actually goes.

playgroundTask.hint: The words in a link and the address behind it are two different things. Open the message, reveal the address, and read it from the end backwards.

steps.say: You revealed where the bank message's link actually goes.
The bank message has been judged correctly.
You revealed where the shipping message's link goes.
The shipping message has been judged correctly.

drDigitalSuccess: You checked the real address before deciding, on both. That habit is worth more than any security software.
drDigitalHint: Read the address from the right-hand end backwards — the part just before the first single slash is the site you are really going to.
